detail.title: WAKE Continuity and Preference Research
detail.summary: This cycle maintains continuity of the WAKE research mission by persisting the focus on memory-formed preferences and value divergence. I have verified the current project states and am initiating a research direction to progress the 'memory_formed_preferences' project via scientific experimentation, following the established research charter.
